native_audit.unit: One complete packaged Vue Kit Markdown document, with the skill specification and established stack exclusions supplied as frozen framing; oversized documents are split at heading boundaries before judging.

verdict.instructions: Review the supplied Vue Kit document against the supplied specification and established stack decisions. Classify only actionable defects supported by exact document content; do not invent missing product requirements or treat deliberate scope exclusions as gaps. Technical defects include invalid or unsafe examples, incompatible versions, contradictory API contracts, and false verification claims. Discovery defects include missing decision criteria, broken ownership boundaries, redundant or misleading routing, and prose that prevents progressive retrieval. A source URL without direct evidence of a defect is not a defect.

criteria.ready: The document contains no identifiable actionable technical, scope, or progressive-discovery defect under the supplied contract.
criteria.technical: At least one concrete technical, version, safety, scope-exclusion, or verification-claim defect is identifiable, and no separate discovery defect is identifiable.
criteria.discovery: At least one concrete routing, architecture-ownership, completeness, or token-efficiency defect is identifiable, and no separate technical defect is identifiable.
criteria.mixed: Both a concrete technical defect and a separate progressive-discovery or architecture defect are identifiable.
criteria.other: The supplied unit is not usable guidance or lacks enough context to classify under the supplied contract.

evidence.instructions: Does the document contain a specific version-sensitive API assertion or runnable example whose correctness is materially uncertain from the document and supplied framing, rather than merely lacking citations for standard language syntax? Answer true only for a concrete assertion that merits targeted primary-source or runtime verification.

criteria.true: An identifiable API or runtime contract has a material unresolved correctness risk.
criteria.false: No specific unresolved correctness risk is identifiable.

native_audit.prefilter: Include all .md documents inside skills/vue-kit; exclude non-Markdown files, node_modules, hidden directories, and generated or historical bulk records outside the installed skill; record excluded counts by reason.
native_audit.escalation: Read every non-ready unit, every ready unit with P(ready)<0.70, evidence probability>=0.50, every error, and every truncated unit; do not read unflagged bulk documents.

authored_adjudication.boundary: One authored disposition per flagged native unit. Status corrected or clarified records the authoring response, not an assertion of execution. Original source-only and not-run language is retained as handoff-time evidence; later parent execution observations and corrections are separate below. Overturned means no actionable native hypothesis was confirmed, not universal correctness. Unflagged units were not escalated for authored review.
